resources.name: GaAs band‑structure and scattering parameters from literature

access.notes: Effective masses for Γ, L, X6, X7 valleys, light‑hole band model parameters, LO phonon energy, deformation potentials, and intervalley coupling constants are available from references such as Phys. Rev. B 36, 6018 (1987) and J. H. Collet, Phys. Rev. B 47, 3160 (1993).
